provenance.provenance_evidence: The project-owned projection passage reproduces the retained calendar body hash exactly. Its artifact manifest records the bounded public-domain 1862 Pustet antecedent, the separate 1962 target, and every editorial transformation; neither witness is represented as owning the projected bytes. The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Differences from the antecedent: token 0: 1962 prints "Deus,"; 1922 Tours Mame reads "Ds:" (edit distance 2); token 3: 1962 prints "beatae Mariae"; 1922 Tours Mame reads "beatz Mariz" (edit distance 2); token 14: 1922 Tours Mame adds ":"; the 1962 has nothing there; token 20: 1962 prints "earn Genetricem"; 1922 Tours Mame reads "eam Genitricem" (edit distance 3); token 27: 1962 prints "intercessionibus"; 1922 Tours Mame reads "intercessidnibus" (edit distance 1); token 30: 1962 prints "eundem"; 1922 Tours Mame reads "eumdem" (edit distance 1); token 37: 1922 Tours Mame adds ":"; the 1962 has nothing there; token 38: 1962 prints "tecum"; 1922 Tours Mame reads "3 contra persecutores Eeclesiv Oratio CCLESLE tue, quésumus, 4 Domine, preces placatus admitte :" (edit distance 83, conclusion); token 40: 1962 prints "et regnat in unitate."; 1922 Tours Mame reads "destrictis" (edit distance 16, conclusion); 1922 Mame prints Genitricem, ejus and adjuvemur where the 1962 prints Genetricem, eius and adiuvemur; 1922 Mame sets the conclusion in parentheses and abbreviates it to Qui.; the 1962 writes Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.; the 1962 prints Christum Filium tuum without the comma that it sets at the Annunciation. Corroboration: 1862 Pustet Ratisbon text-layer lines 13256-13280: 34 of 44 tokens identical after normalisation (n-gram similarity 0.76); 1604 Vatican typical: swept end to end, no matching text (best window n-gram similarity 0.41, which is noise).

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui de beatae Mariae Virginis utero Verbum tuum, Angelo nuntiante,
carnem suscipere voluisti: praesta supplicibus tuis; ut, qui vere eam
Genetricem Dei credimus, ejus apud te intercessionibus adjuvemur. Per eundem
Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in
unitate.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Tua, Domine, propitiatione, et beatae Mariae semper Virginis, Unigeniti tui
Matris, intercessione, ad perpetuam atque praesentem haec oblatio nobis
proficiat prosperitatem et pacem. Per eundem Dominum.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Haec nos communio, Domine, purget a crimine: et, intercedente beata Virgine
Dei Genetrice Maria, caelestis remedii faciat esse consortes. Per eundem
Dominum.
